title: Verify the Send to Portal button is not visible for Technician
preconds:
Log in to ShopView as a user assigned the Technician role. (Send to Portal requires Full View; Technician has Tech View).
At least one work order exists.
steps:
1. Open a work order.
2. Look for the Send to Portal button.
expected: The Send to Portal button is NOT visible anywhere on the work order.
